rationale: The 5-minute ATR of $0.04 is extremely compressed, meaning the risk/reward on any directional bet is minimal relative to spread and slippage costs. While the stock beat earnings yet gapped down 13.6% (classic sell-the-news dynamic) and is consolidating near the day's low, the lack of a clear exhaustion signal (no volume spike, no reversal candle) and the continued downtrend from open to current price make a long risky; a short near the day's low with only 0.66% distance to that low offers very little room before invalidation. With an already-dented daily loss budget and no historical comparable setups, the mechanical evidence does not support a high-probability entry in either direction.
